title: Naval on Joe Rogan: Wealth, Leverage, Happiness and Meaning
summary: Naval lays out his core framework: own equity rather than rent your time, build leverage and specific knowledge, protect your time with an aspirational hourly rate, and treat happiness and peace as trainable choices. He also covers the unbundling of firms, UBI, and why understanding basics beats memorizing.

principles.text: You won't get rich renting out your time; own equity in a business, as owner, investor or brand.
principles.quote: the first thing you have to do is you have to own a piece of a business you need to have equity either as an owner an investor shareholder or a brand that you're building

principles.text: Output is non-linear: who you work with and what you do matter more than hours worked.
principles.quote: what you do who you do with how you do it way more important than how hard you work right outputs are non-linear based on the quality of the work that you put in

principles.text: Be authentic: do what you love and know better than anyone, then add leverage and put your name on it.
principles.quote: be authentic and then figure out how to map that to what society actually wants apply some leverage put your name on it so you take the risks but you gain the rewards have ownership and equity in what you do

principles.text: Pick an aspirational hourly rate and refuse to spend time below it; this makes meetings and low-value tasks easy to drop.
principles.quote: pick an aspirational hourly rate aspirational it has to be a little ludicrous

principles.text: Work like a lion, not a cow: sprint, rest, reassess, repeat rather than linear nine-to-five output.
principles.quote: you train hard then you sprint then you rest then you reassess you get your feedback loop then you train some more then you sprint again

principles.text: Wealth creation is positive-sum: create something new and exchange it, unlike zero-sum status games.
principles.quote: it is a positive sum game you create something brand new you exchange it with me for something brand new i've created this higher utility for both of us
